name: Soyuz TM-4
about: Soyuz TM-4 (1987-104A), a crewed vehicle (7K-STM), launched 1987 Dec 21. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1988 Jan 21), held fixed
docked to S17845; GCAT's tables give no later phase (undocking, landing)
